notes.key_messages: It is important that candidates have a thorough knowledge and understanding of all topics on the syllabus Candidates are advised to read through each item very carefully before selecting an option on the answer sheet. This will ensure that they know exactly what is required.
notes.general_comments: A large number of candidates possessed a good understanding of double-entry book-keeping and were able to select the correct key to many items on the paper. These candidates earned high marks.
